full_page.content:
c. 1949
The following is a faithful transcription of the photo copy of handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Dec. 20th
God bless you Miss Beatrice Lamb. Glad to hear from you. I hope you keep well. Please say a prayer that poor Fr. Sol. catch up with out cor- respondence.
(Printed Greeting)
May the Christmas blessings of the Infant Savior be with you throughout the coming New Year
(Fr. Solanus' handwritting) - With you and yours
Hope our one-time little boy-friend Philip is keeping well
Best regards and God's blessing to all.
... . God to remember that on this star
(earth) that we are living on, there is no real Heaven - and that : "Whom the Lord loveth, He Chasteneth". ...
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Miss Beatrice Lamb 36087 Bartell St. Richmond, Michigan 48062
